title: vigna luteola var. angustifolia
intro: Vigna luteola var. angustifolia, commonly known as Indian snakeroot, is a plant species of the family Fabaceae. Indian snakeroot is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Vigna luteola var. angustifolia are attributed to its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
